name: Configure Alpha Neurofeedback Workspace in OpenBCI GUI
description:
You are a neurofeedback technician at a clinical practice that uses OpenBCI for alpha-wave anxiety treatment sessions. You need to configure a standardized workspace that can be reused across patient visits.

The OpenBCI GUI is open at the System Control Panel. Configure and document a complete alpha neurofeedback monitoring workspace with the following end state:

- An active EEG session running in Synthetic mode
- A 4-panel display layout with these specific widgets: Time Series in panel 1, FFT Plot in panel 2, Band Power in panel 3, and Focus in panel 4
- Bandpass filter set to 1–40 Hz (low cutoff: 1 Hz, high cutoff: 40 Hz)
- Expert Mode enabled
- A screenshot taken to document the workspace (requires Expert Mode active — the 'm' key saves screenshots to ~/Documents/OpenBCI_GUI/Screenshots/)
- The full configuration saved as a settings file in ~/Documents/OpenBCI_GUI/Settings/

The saved settings file allows this exact workspace to be loaded again for future patient sessions without manual reconfiguration.
